articles.title: Soda ash dependency threatens India's clean tech ambitions, reveals new report
articles.summary: A new study reveals that despite deteriorating relations with Türkiye following last year’s conflict with Pakistan, India continues to import soda ash in large quantities, negatively impacting its domestic industry. Industry experts are calling for immediate regulations on soda ash imports to support Indian manufacturers and reinforce the country’s ambitions in clean tech manufacturing.

articles.title: Centre extends Zakir Naik's IRF ban till 2031 over 'sinister anti-India designs'
articles.summary: The Centre on Friday declared radical Islamic preacher Zakir Naik’s NGO Islamic Research Foundation, (IRF), as an ‘unlawful association’ for a further period of five years, on the ground that the outfit and its members, particularly Dr Naik, have been encouraging and aiding others to promote disharmony, enmity and ill-will between different religious communities and groups.
